verdict.rationale: Linear documents team-based visibility controls. Private sub-teams can be restricted to parent-team members or hidden except to directly invited members, and initiatives led by private teams are visible only to team members. Okta-managed access also applies existing Linear permissions. This gives real control over who can view work, but the evidence never describes role definitions or edit-level permissions. Missing for 10: documented roles (e.g., admin/member/guest), granular edit vs. view permission controls, per-object permission settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
